employer_specifics: The role leads Smartsheet's most complex AI deployments end-to-end: technical discovery through production deployment through handoff to the solutions org, owning the customer relationship throughout.

Core deliverables are multi-agent architectures, client-specific MCP resource packs ('personalized intelligence from the server so every connected AI surface gets smarter for that customer'), and Deployment Kits written so a solutions consultant with no engineering background can follow them — used by 200+ solutions consultants and partners.

The FDE contributes to an 'intelligence loop': weekly Applied AI strategy sessions, strategic memos, Agent Bricks and Skills, RFCs for platform improvements; framed as 'building a function, not filling a role' with junior FDEs to mentor.

Smartsheet (20+ years, Bellevue WA, ~3,000 staff, taken private by Blackstone/Vista in Jan 2025) is repositioning around 'uniting human teams with AI agents'; nice-to-haves name technical-founder background, Databricks/AWS Bedrock/Temporal, Strands SDK/LangChain/open-source MCP server contributions, German/French, and GDPR / UK-EU AI Act governance familiarity.
verify.red_flags: (1) Hard requirement: 6–10+ years production software engineering including 3+ years deploying AI/ML to production, plus a proven track record leading complex enterprise engagements (security reviews, systems 'organisations depend on') — Phil has no formal SWE employment history and ~17 months of production agent work at SME scale; a screener applying this literally will reject. (2) 25–50% domestic and international travel required — not disclosed in the scout report. (3) Salary unstated for a permanent role. (4) Req open since 1 May 2026 (~16 weeks), refreshed 27 Jul — may be hard to fill or slow-moving. (5) US-HQ'd; some US-hours overlap likely though not stated. (6) CV upload required (paste-as-text alternative exists). Positives: Smartsheet's own Greenhouse board, no account needed, explicitly welcomes 'nontraditional paths' and lists technical-founder background as a nice-to-have.
verify.decision_reason: Listing is live, the employer is confirmed private, and the Greenhouse form needs no account — but three things only Phil can decide before effort is spent: whether to apply against a stated 6–10+ years production-SWE / 3+ years production-AI requirement that his CV does not literally meet (the role is otherwise squarely agentic/MCP/FDE, fit reframing possible via the 'nontraditional paths' and technical-founder lines); whether he will accept 25–50% domestic and international travel; and which CV to upload (required file; pay unstated permanent, likely within band for a Sr FDE at a PE-owned US SaaS but unconfirmed). Not a drop: nothing hard-excludes it and it is the strongest-provenance agentic role in the batch.

pack.cover_note: Since March 2025 I have built and run Albie, a 24/7 autonomous multi-channel operator on the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK: WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord in; tool use, scheduled tasks, persistent memory and SQLite underneath; Python and TypeScript throughout. My company runs on it daily, and the same stack backs six live client engagements across construction, equestrian, property, hospitality and ecommerce. One of those, The Wall Group, lifted net profit 17% year on year from the workflows I integrated. Your Deployment Kits must be followable by 200+ solutions consultants with no engineering background; handing over agent systems that SME owners run without me is what the last seventeen months have been. I have designed rubric-graded, mutation-tested RL evaluation environments, and eighteen years of commercial leadership before this means I own the customer relationship, not just the build. Based in Derry with UK right to work; remote, travelling as required.
